components.text: Welcome to Meetlocals! Here are some Helpful Tips to get you started: 1. Upload at least one picture. More pictures = more action! 2. Help others get to know you and complete your profile. 3. Take the initiative: send Friend Requests and respectful Messages. ;) 4. Safety Reminders:      - Only log in at www.meetlocals.com. We only ask you to log in once.      - NEVER give your login information to anyone! Thank you and have fun! :)
